title: Better Than KFC Chicken Strips

items: 2 tbsp hot sauce / tobasco / hot and sweet sauce

method: Cut your chicken breast into strips, as small or big as you like
Crush your cornflakes and add in the spices and set aside
In another bowl, beat the eggs and hot sauce together
Dip your chicken in the egg and then the cornflake mix and place on a plate
Air fry the strips for 5- 10 minutes, this will depend on the size of your strips and thickness mine took 7 minutes, turn them half way through
Serve with hot and sweet sauce, barbeque sauce or just plain tomato ketchup whichever you prefer
caption:
better than KFC chicken strips
zero oil | high protein 

Ingredients: 
450 grams chicken breast, I use @licious_foods 
2-3 cups cornflakes
2-3 tsp chilli powder
1 - 2tsp black pepper
1 tsp salt
2 tsp oregano / italian spice seasoning
2 eggs
2 tbsp hot sauce / tobasco / hot and sweet sauce

Method
cut your chicken breast into strips, as small or big as you like
crush your cornflakes and add in the spices and set aside
in another bowl, beat the eggs and hot sauce together
dip your chicken in the egg and then the cornflake mix and place on a plate
preheat airfryer to 190 degrees 
air fry the strips for 5- 10 minutes, this will depend on the size of your strips and thickness mine took 7 minutes, turn them half way through 

serve with hot and sweet sauce, barbeque sauce or just plain tomato ketchup whichever you prefer
